name: Dynamic SDF Ray Marching with Structured Buffers
aliases: SDF Ray Marching with Dynamic Object Buffers
SDF Ray Marching with GPU Buffers
definition: A technique for rendering dynamic, complex scenes using Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) by streaming object data from the CPU to the GPU in structured buffers, allowing for per-pixel evaluation of multiple objects without hardcoding the scene in the shader.
summary: Dynamic SDF Ray Marching with Structured Buffers renders dynamic scenes by streaming object data to the GPU, enabling per-pixel evaluation of multiple moving objects without hardcoding geometry in the shader.
